metadata.title: Top 100 Pure-Play Digital AI Companies 2026
metadata.subtitle: Ranked by a normalized composite of ARR and Valuation

scoring.normalization: log-min-max scaling (log10 of the raw metric, then min-max rescaled to [0,1])
scoring.missing_data_policy: If ARR is undisclosed but a recent revenue or run-rate exists, we substitute it. If both metrics are missing the company is dropped from the ranked list. ARR < $25M and/or valuation < $250M businesses are usually too small to be top-100 material; they appear in the appendix only.

companies.arr_source: Not cleanly disclosed — AIP revenue not broken out separately; FY26 total revenue guide is ~$8.15B but AIP-attributed slice is not published
companies.arr_attribution_note: AIP (Artificial Intelligence Platform) drives the US commercial business (~$3.4B FY26 guide) but Palantir does not disclose AIP revenue as a separate line; treating as missing.
companies.summary: Foundry + AIP platforms. AIP drives most growth but is not separately disclosed; AI-attributed ARR is null per company.

companies.name: Schrodinger
companies.arr_source: Not applicable — Bunsen (agentic AI co-scientist) launched in mid-2026 in early access; pre-revenue. Core ACV ($218-228M FY26) is physics-based simulation, not pure AI
companies.arr_attribution_note: Schrodinger calls itself 'physics + AI' but the bulk of revenue ($200M+ ACV) is physics-based molecular simulation. AI agent product Bunsen launched mid-2026 and has no disclosed ARR.
companies.summary: Computational chemistry. AI-attributed ARR is null — Bunsen agent is pre-revenue; core is physics simulation.

companies.name: Samsara
companies.arr_source: Not disclosed — Samsara sells sensor hardware (cameras, GPS, telematics) with AI on top; the AI-only software layer ARR is not broken out
companies.arr_attribution_note: Total company revenue is $1.5B FY26; AI-attributed software-only ARR is not disclosed separately. AI is a feature, not the dominant business line.
companies.summary: Cameras + sensors with AI features for fleet + industrial ops. AI layer ARR not separately disclosed. Borderline 'digital AI' — included on valuation strength only.

companies.name: ServiceNow (Now Assist AI)
companies.arr_source: ServiceNow Q2 2026 financial results; management earnings call
companies.arr_attribution_note: AI-attributed ARR is Now Assist + AI portfolio = $1.5B FY26 forecast (vs. $15.8B total subscription revenue); only ~10% of subscription revenue is currently classified as AI.
companies.summary: Workflow platform with Now Assist gen-AI. Now Assist crossed $1B ACV in Q2 2026; tracked to $1.5B FY26.

companies.summary: CRM + Agentforce AI agents; listed. AI-attributed ARR is Agentforce only ($800M).

exclusions.reason: Excluded from the ranked top 100 because the company is hardware-first, robotics-first, semiconductor-first, or physically-manufactured goods. They are not 'pure-play digital AI'.
